name: SLIM (near Shioli crater)

outcomeDetail.summary: One main-engine nozzle separated at about 50 m altitude and the lander touched down in an unplanned attitude about 55 m from target. Its solar cells faced west, so it made no power until the Sun's direction changed; it later survived three lunar nights.

sources.label: JAXA SLIM project review briefing, Dec 2024

JAXA press release, SLIM operations ended (26 Aug 2024)

blurb: A pinpoint landing in the wrong attitude: its panels faced away from the Sun until the Sun moved.
